## Load packages

```{r setup}
pacman::p_load(here, mixOmics, dplyr, tidyr, tibble, purrr, ggplot2, patchwork, readr, writexl)
here::i_am("07_Multivariate/03_spls/a_script/03_spls.qmd")
```

## Read proteins and phenotype

`phenotype.csv` holds one row per leg with vastus lateralis (`vl_`) and rectus femoris (`rf_`)
cross-sectional area (CSA) and echo intensity before and after training.

```{r read}
stage <- here("07_Multivariate", "03_spls")
proteins <- readRDS(here("01_Preprocess", "02_Quantification", "c_data", "proteins.rds"))
phenotype <- read_csv(here("00_Input", "phenotype.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
gene_of <- set_names(proteins$genes$Genes, rownames(proteins))
```

## Changes per leg

Protein change is each leg's T2 minus T1 on the log2 scale; outcome change is post minus pre, as
in `03_Protein_Association`. Treatment comes from the sample table.

```{r changes}
outcomes <- c(
  vl_csa = "VL CSA change (cm²)", rf_csa = "RF CSA change (cm²)",
  vl_echo = "VL echo change (a.u.)", rf_echo = "RF echo change (a.u.)"
)
legs <- proteins$targets |>
  mutate(leg_id = paste(participant, leg, sep = "_")) |>
  select(leg_id, participant, leg, treatment, timepoint, sample_id) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = timepoint, values_from = sample_id) |>
  drop_na(T1, T2) |>
  left_join(select(phenotype, -treatment), by = c("participant", "leg"),
    relationship = "one-to-one") |>
  mutate(
    vl_csa = vl_csa_post_cm2 - vl_csa_pre_cm2,
    rf_csa = rf_csa_post_cm2 - rf_csa_pre_cm2,
    vl_echo = vl_echo_post_au - vl_echo_pre_au,
    rf_echo = rf_echo_post_au - rf_echo_pre_au
  )
change <- t(proteins$E[, legs$T2] - proteins$E[, legs$T1])
rownames(change) <- legs$leg_id
count(legs, treatment)
```

## Fits

Sparse PLS regression with one outcome (sPLS1) builds a score from a weighted sum of a few
proteins' changes, chosen to predict the outcome change. Each outcome gets three fits:

- BFR legs alone and HLRT legs alone, one leg per participant, so cross-validation folds are folds
  of people;
- both arms pooled, a sensitivity run with twice the legs. A participant's two legs grow together
  (r = 0.57 for VL CSA), so `perf()` here holds out each participant's two legs together.
  `tune.spls()` takes only a number of folds, so the pooled panel size is chosen on folds that can
  split a participant; that choice may lean optimistic.

```{r fits}
fits_to_run <- expand_grid(outcome = names(outcomes), fit = c("BFR", "HLRT", "pooled")) |>
  mutate(rows = map(fit, function(f) {
    if (f == "pooled") seq_len(nrow(legs)) else which(legs$treatment == f)
  }))
fits_to_run |> mutate(n_legs = lengths(rows)) |> select(-rows)
```

## Tune, fit and cross-validate

`tune.spls()` tries panels of 5 to 1,000 proteins on each of two components and keeps the size
with the lowest mean absolute error (MAE). mixOmics divides each absolute miss by the outcome's
variance, so this MAE compares panel sizes within an outcome but is not in the outcome's units.
Cross-validation is 5-fold, repeated 50 times. `spls()` fits the chosen panel on all legs of the
fit, and `perf()` reruns cross-validation for the mean squared error of prediction (MSEP, also
relative to the outcome's variance, so 1 means no better than predicting the mean), R² and Q².
Q² is 1 minus the prediction error over the outcome's variance: above 0.0975 a component predicts
better than chance by the package's rule, and below 0 it predicts worse than the mean. The pooled
fits' `perf()` uses one fold per participant. The panel size was chosen on the same data, so the
errors are somewhat optimistic; there is no permutation reference.

```{r fit}
keep_grid <- c(5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 200, 500, 1000)
fit_spls <- function(outcome, fit, rows) {
  x <- change[rows, ]
  y <- legs[[outcome]][rows]
  tuned <- tune.spls(x, y, ncomp = 2, test.keepX = keep_grid, validation = "Mfold", folds = 5,
    nrepeat = 50, measure = "MAE", seed = 2026)
  model <- spls(x, y, ncomp = 2, keepX = tuned$choice.keepX)
  performance <- if (fit == "pooled") {
    perf(model, validation = "Mfold", folds = split(seq_along(rows), legs$participant[rows]))
  } else {
    perf(model, validation = "Mfold", folds = 5, nrepeat = 50, seed = 2026)
  }
  list(tuned = tuned, model = model, performance = performance)
}
fits <- pmap(fits_to_run, fit_spls)
names(fits) <- paste(fits_to_run$outcome, fits_to_run$fit, sep = "_")
```

## Prediction error

One row per outcome, fit and component.

```{r models}
measure <- function(performance, name) performance$measures[[name]]$summary$mean
model_summary <- pmap(fits_to_run, function(outcome, fit, rows) {
  result <- fits[[paste(outcome, fit, sep = "_")]]
  tibble(
    outcome = outcome, fit = fit, n_legs = length(rows), component = 1:2,
    keep_x = unname(result$tuned$choice.keepX),
    tune_mae = map2_dbl(keep_x, component,
      \(k, h) result$tuned$error.rate[as.character(k), h]),
    msep = measure(result$performance, "MSEP"),
    rmsep = measure(result$performance, "RMSEP"),
    r2 = measure(result$performance, "R2"),
    q2 = measure(result$performance, "Q2"),
    q2_total = measure(result$performance, "Q2.total")
  )
}) |>
  list_rbind()
model_summary |> mutate(across(where(is.double), \(x) signif(x, 3)))
```

## Panels

Every selected protein, with its loading and its stability across the cross-validation refits.

```{r panels}
panels <- imap(fits, function(result, name) {
  map(1:2, function(h) {
    loading <- result$model$loadings$X[, h]
    stable <- result$performance$features$stability.X[[h]]
    tibble(protein = names(loading), loading = unname(loading)) |>
      filter(loading != 0) |>
      mutate(
        outcome = sub("_(BFR|HLRT|pooled)$", "", name), fit = sub(".*_", "", name),
        component = h, gene = gene_of[protein], stability = unname(stable[protein]),
        .before = protein
      ) |>
      arrange(desc(abs(loading)))
  }) |>
    list_rbind()
}) |>
  list_rbind()
panels |> summarise(proteins = n(), stable_80 = sum(stability >= 0.8),
  .by = c(outcome, fit, component))
```

## Held-out predictions

`perf()` does not return its predictions, so the figure's predicted values come from one
cross-validation pass written with `spls()` and `predict()`: component 1 at the tuned panel size,
the same folds as `perf()` (5 folds in a single arm, one participant per fold when pooled).

```{r predictions}
set.seed(2026)
held_out <- pmap(fits_to_run, function(outcome, fit, rows) {
  x <- change[rows, ]
  y <- legs[[outcome]][rows]
  keep_x <- fits[[paste(outcome, fit, sep = "_")]]$tuned$choice.keepX[[1]]
  folds <- if (fit == "pooled") {
    split(seq_along(rows), legs$participant[rows])
  } else {
    split(sample(seq_along(rows)), rep(1:5, length.out = length(rows)))
  }
  predicted <- numeric(length(rows))
  for (test in folds) {
    model <- spls(x[-test, ], y[-test], ncomp = 1, keepX = keep_x)
    predicted[test] <- predict(model, x[test, , drop = FALSE])$predict[, 1, 1]
  }
  tibble(outcome = outcome, fit = fit, leg_id = legs$leg_id[rows],
    treatment = legs$treatment[rows], observed = y, predicted = predicted)
}) |>
  list_rbind()
held_out |> summarise(r = cor(observed, predicted), .by = c(outcome, fit))
```

## Figures

One page per outcome: held-out predicted against observed change for each fit, with the
correlation and component 1's Q²; below, the 20 largest component 1 loadings of each fit, shaded
by stability.

```{r figures}
#| fig-height: 10
arm_colours <- c(BFR = "#D55E00", HLRT = "#0072B2")

prediction_plot <- function(this_outcome, this_fit) {
  rows <- filter(held_out, outcome == this_outcome, fit == this_fit)
  q2 <- filter(model_summary, outcome == this_outcome, fit == this_fit, component == 1)$q2
  ggplot(rows, aes(observed, predicted, colour = treatment)) +
    geom_abline(linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey70") +
    geom_point(size = 1.4, show.legend = TRUE) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = arm_colours, limits = names(arm_colours)) +
    labs(
      title = this_fit, x = "Observed", y = "Held-out predicted", colour = NULL,
      subtitle = sprintf("r = %.2f, Q² = %.2f", cor(rows$observed, rows$predicted), q2)
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 7)
}

loading_plot <- function(this_outcome, this_fit) {
  panels |>
    filter(outcome == this_outcome, fit == this_fit, component == 1) |>
    slice_max(abs(loading), n = 20, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    ggplot(aes(loading, reorder(gene, loading), fill = stability)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "grey85", high = "grey15", limits = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(x = "Component 1 loading", y = NULL, fill = "Stability") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 6)
}

pages <- map(names(outcomes), function(name) {
  fit_names <- c("BFR", "HLRT", "pooled")
  wrap_plots(map(fit_names, \(f) prediction_plot(name, f)), nrow = 1) /
    wrap_plots(map(fit_names, \(f) loading_plot(name, f)), nrow = 1) +
    plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1.6), guides = "collect") +
    plot_annotation(title = outcomes[[name]])
})
pages[[1]]

pdf(file.path(stage, "b_reports", "03_spls.pdf"), width = 8.27, height = 11.69)
walk(pages, print)
invisible(dev.off())
```
